whatThisIs: THE ARTISAN FORM, DECLARED ONCE FOR BOTH PORTALS AND BOTH CLIENTS (owner decision, 2026-10-17).
The designer portal adopted the documentation portal's form. This file is byte-identical in the
two repositories; each repository's backend test compares it with the sibling checkout's copy
when one is present, so a change made in one repository and not the other fails there.
It declares the labels and their order on each client, the words a client shows, the words a
client may no longer show, the two required dates and the sentence that asks for them, and the
body key a client sends to be held to the rule. The sentence vectors are run by the server, the
web helper and the Android helper in both repositories.
transition: A body WITHOUT formContract is the old shape and is accepted unchanged, so an outbox entry
queued by an older build still replays. A body WITH formContract >= 2 is refused (422, the
sentence below) when it leaves a required date empty. On an edit, the stored value counts for a
date the body leaves out; an explicit null does not. Existing records without the dates still
load and display, and an edit made from the artisan form asks for them.
The same holds for each required answer below: a body WITH formContract >= 2 that leaves it
unanswered is refused with its sentence; on an edit the stored answer counts. A record whose
Pehchan card says Yes with no number on file still loads; an edit from the artisan form asks for
the number or a No before it saves.
